name: Millipede
method: Full original visual inspection by Codex
observation: Cylindrical brown ringed trunk, short clubbed antennae and a dense fringe of short legs differ clearly from the centipedes. No tail stinger or giant splayed legs. The image does not establish two leg pairs on each diplosegment; most legs overlap at their roots and far legs are hard to trace. Large simple-looking eye and glossy metallic-looking cuticle remain anatomical/style review holds.
